'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[Oman]] reaches an agreement with [[France]] and the [[United Kingdom]] to ensure safe navigation through the country's waterways including the [[Gulf of Oman]] and [[Strait of Hormuz]]. *[[Mali War]]
**[[2026 Mali offensives]]
***The [[Al-Qaeda]]-linked [[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] and [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] [[Azawad Liberation Front]] separatists launch coordinated attacks on the [[Mali]]an [[Communes of Mali|communes]] and towns of [[Aguelhok]], [[Anéfis]], [[Gao]], and [[Sévaré]]. The [[Malian army]] says it has repelled the assaults, while local sources report continuing fighting. *[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Battle of Kostiantynivka]]
***[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[President of Ukraine|president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] and the [[General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces]] deny [[Russia]]'s claim that it captured [[Kostiantynivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], yesterday, saying [[Ukrainian forces]] still control the city and continue defensive operations there. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/ukraine-denies-russian-capture-key-eastern-city-kostiantynivka-2026-07-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**Over 50 [[Houthis|Houthi]] fighters and 16 [[Yemeni Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed during clashes in [[Hodeidah]], [[Yemen]]. Twenty-two more soldiers are also wounded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/5/at-least-15-yemeni-government-troops-killed-in-hodeidah-fighting (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[China]] releases pastor [[Jin Mingri]], the founder of the [[Beijing Zion Church]], after [[Penal system in China|detaining]] him since October, with [[ChinaAid.org]] saying officials presented the release as a goodwill gesture following [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[2026 state visit by Donald Trump to China|visit to China]] last May. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2026/07/1481117/china-frees-jailed-pastor-ezra-jin (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**A Russian [[cultural center]] in [[Chișinău]], [[Moldova]], closes after [[Munteanu Cabinet|the government]] orders its shutdown, citing security concerns linked to Russian influence and [[Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|drone incidents]] amid strained bilateral relations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-cultural-centre-closes-moldova-after-government-order-2026-07-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Slovak referendum]]
**[[Slovakia|Slovaks]] vote in a [[referendum]] to decide whether to cancel life payments for [[Prime Minister of Slovakia|prime ministers]] after their terms expire and whether to reopen the office of an [[anti-corruption]] agency. The referendum is invalidated due to low turnout. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-fico-referendum-corruption-60d7cb3ae150739a926056afae9dc2a8 (AP)]
